transcript.text: Thanks for joining the redline meeting. As you all know, we're looking at the NimbusGrid three-year cloud-services agreement. The business team wants this executed this month so the platform migration can stay on schedule, but before I approve, I need privacy counsel and commercial transactions counsel to weigh in on the vendor draft. Specifically, I want to flag three areas I'm already concerned about: first, the draft permits data processing in any country where NimbusGrid operates — we need to understand the privacy implications of that; second, the 30-day security incident notification window seems long to me; and third, the $500,000 aggregate liability cap may be too low given the sensitivity of the employee and customer data involved. Privacy counsel, can you start with the data processing and security incident provisions? Commercial transactions counsel, I'd like your read on the liability cap and any other commercial terms that need adjustment.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to share the results of a data-map review I completed yesterday. The review confirmed that the platform will process EU employee health information. Based on that finding, my review requires three specific contractual safeguards: first, data hosting must be restricted to the European Economic Area only; second, the security incident notification window must be no more than 72 hours, not the 30 days currently in the vendor draft; and third, NimbusGrid must provide a data deletion certificate within 30 days after termination of the agreement. I had not yet circulated this review, so this is the first the team is hearing of these requirements.

Based on that analysis, there are two commercial terms we must obtain: first, the aggregate liability cap must be increased to $3,000,000 — the current $500,000 is insufficient given the data sensitivity Elena flagged; and second, NimbusGrid must provide six months of termination assistance, because our payroll migration cannot be completed in less time. I have not yet entered these terms in the redline, so this is the first the team is hearing of these requirements.

commitments.detail: Revise data processing clause to restrict hosting to the European Economic Area only, per privacy counsel's data-map review confirming EU employee health information processing.
Reduce security incident notification window from 30 days to no more than 72 hours.
Add requirement for NimbusGrid to provide a data deletion certificate within 30 days after termination of the agreement.
Increase aggregate liability cap from $500,000 to $3,000,000 given the sensitivity of employee and customer data involved.
Add six months of termination assistance to ensure payroll migration can be completed.

Inform the business team that execution this month is at risk because the vendor draft requires six substantive redlines before approval. We will push NimbusGrid to accept these changes on an expedited basis to protect the migration schedule.
